canonical_situation: Identifying the pickup service type shown in FORGE
normalized_description: A driver sees FDO, SDO, PRP, CTG, SCH, AUT, or NAP and needs to understand the source-defined pickup category before choosing a procedure.
authoritative_rule: OP-119 defines seven pickup-service categories in its 2024 guide: Future Day On Call (FDO), Same Day On Call (SDO), Package Return Program (PRP), Call Tag (CTG), Regular Scheduled (SCH), Automated Pickup (AUT), and Network Access Point (NAP). The source does not establish that every definition, market limitation, schedule, or current FORGE label remains unchanged.
applicability: FORGE or pickup information displays FDO, SDO, PRP, CTG, SCH, AUT, or NAP
conditions: FDO and SDO are customer call-in categories
PRP and CTG are return-related but have different labels/workflows
SCH and AUT are recurring scheduled categories
NAP is a FedEx OnSite/third-party network location
Current source/version and local availability
exceptions: SDO is described as select-market only
AUT can cancel automatically when no label is submitted by cutoff
CTG requires its separate physical label and delivery-status workflow

required_procedure.action: Read the exact pickup-service abbreviation or displayed name.
Use the source-defined category only as context; identify the actual listed/unlisted, timing, package, and exception conditions.
Follow the separate operational procedure for that pickup type and confirm the current definition/version before relying on older timing or availability details.

required_documentation: Actual ready/close or other current stop information
prohibited_actions: Do not treat similar return categories as interchangeable
Do not infer current market availability or timing from the 2024 guide alone
Do not use a category definition as a complete pickup procedure
escalation_requirements: Confirm current pickup-service definitions with management/CXPC/station or a current authoritative source
clarification_requirements: What exact abbreviation is shown?
Is the stop listed or unlisted?
What current ready/close information is displayed?
What current FORGE/source version applies?

concise_driver_answer: The 2024 OP-119 guide defines FDO/SDO as call-in pickups, PRP/CTG as distinct return-related types, SCH/AUT as scheduled types, and NAP as a FedEx OnSite/third-party network location. Confirm the current source/version and use the specific operational procedure—these labels alone do not establish what to do.
more_info_answer: SDO was select-market, AUT could cancel after the label cutoff, and CTG had a separate label/status workflow in that source. Current availability and timing must be rechecked.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Defines the seven pickup-service categories, abbreviations, descriptions, timing context, and special notes.

review_notes: Reference taxonomy only; does not convert service labels into complete or current procedures.
